messages:
sylvia-csm: Quick QBR/EBR sync — AtlasOps EBR scheduled for 2024-03-06 11:00 PT. Need final deck, action items, and exec alignment. Who can own which slides?

maria-cs: I'll take onboarding/status slide. I'll pull last 30-day activation & onboarding funnel numbers. Need access to the enablement dashboard.

aj-sales: I'll cover renewal health + risks. Early warning: renewal is on a 60-day clock and there's a potential pushback on pricing. I'll draft recommended exec asks. @james-cto can you join the exec portion?

derek-technical: I'll own reliability/incidents slide. Short summary: 99.6% last quarter, outage on 02/12 (15m) — fixed with hotpatch. Will include RCA bullet.

bryan-product: Roadmap/commitments — I can contribute two slides: roadmap items we've promised + timeline for integrations they care about.

sylvia-csm: Draft deck link: https://company.box.com/s/atlasops-qbr-draft (please comment directly). Deadline to freeze deck: EOD 2024-03-04.

maria-cs: Got it. For enablement metrics, can someone grant me dashboard read to 'atlasops-customer' workspace? cc @derek-technical for perms.

derek-technical: Granting now. Also attaching the incident snippet I'll include:
```
02/12 14:03: CPU spike on gw-12 -> autoscaler behaved as expected; failed pod restart due to disk IO; hotpatch applied; mitigation: increased pod probe time.
```

aj-sales: Action item: prepare renewal playbook slide with recommended concessions + exec ask (30m meeting with CTO + product sponsor). I'll draft and post by Wednesday.

sylvia-csm: Two asks from me: 1) capture 2 customer quotes / success metrics for slide 2) a single slide 'ask' for execs (specific ask + impact). Keep asks concrete.

bryan-product: I'll add one quote from the beta feature and metric (reduced inference latency 35%). Need the exact numbers from infra — @derek-technical please confirm.

nora-bot: Reminder: EBR scheduled 2024-03-06 11:00 PT — meeting invite sent to attendees.

aj-sales: Risk note — renewal likely is high priority but procurement timeline may slip 2–3 weeks. Recommend we propose a 3-month bridge discount + deliverable milestone to keep momentum.

sylvia-csm: Exec alignment — we should have a 15m pre-brief with @james-cto and VP Sales on 2024-03-05 09:00 PT. Can you confirm availability?

james-cto: Available 03-05 09:00. I'll review the 'ask' slide; please send the short brief (<= 200 words) by EOD 03-04.

maria-cs: I'll compile onboarding KPIs + 2 customer quotes and post to the deck by 03-04 EOD.

sylvia-csm: Great. Updated action items:
- maria-cs: onboarding KPIs + quotes (due 03-04 EOD)
- aj-sales: renewal playbook + exec asks (due 03-04 EOD)
- derek-technical: incident RCA + infra metrics (due 03-04 EOD)
- bryan-product: roadmap slides + confirm metric (due 03-04 EOD)
- sylvia-csm: assemble deck + run pre-brief with execs (03-05 09:00 PT)

Please react with :thumbsup: when you've added your slides. We'll keep thread for any last-minute changes.
